blocks.text: Pitt Meadows condos and townhomes by price band, October 2026

21 condos and townhomes sold in October against 49 listed. The price band with the most sales was $500,001 to $600,000, with 7 sold (33% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $500,001 to $600,000 at 50%.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Pitt Meadows condo stock clusters on two corridors only: Harris Road in the centre and the north Harris Road / 190A Street pocket.
The City of Pitt Meadows is a Metro Vancouver municipality between the Pitt River to the west and Maple Ridge to the east, with the Fraser River along its south edge.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Every Pitt Meadows condo purchase runs on the same two documents: the Form B Information Certificate and the depreciation report the strata must now renew every five years.

blocks.text: Pitt Meadows Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Pitt Meadows has one public secondary school only, Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue, so every condo address in the city feeds the same grades 8 to 12 school.

The city has four public elementary schools in the district list: Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Road), Davie Jones (12030 Blakely Road), Edith McDermott (12178 Bonson Road) and Highland Park (18961 Advent Road).
A replacement Pitt Meadows Secondary is in design and development after August 2024 provincial funding, per School District 42's facilities plan page.
The airport, Pitt Meadows Regional Airport (YPK) at 18799 Airport Way, sits in the city's south-west, under the flight paths a west-side condo buyer should ask about.
